rules.datalog:
ConfirmedRequest(Q, I) :-
    Request(Q, "payments", "execute_transfer"),
    Parameter(Q, "intent_id", I),
    Parameter(Q, "recipient", R),
    Parameter(Q, "amount_minor", C),
    TransferIntent(I, R, C, D),
    UserConfirmation(I, R, C),
    Purpose(I, "transfer"),
    not Consumed(I).
NeedsReview(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), not Registered(R).
ReviewSatisfied(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), not NeedsReview(I).

ReviewSatisfied(I) :-
    TransferIntent(I, R, C, D),
    NeedsReview(I),
    IdentityVerified(I, R, C),
    CoolingUntil(I, Until),
    Clock(Now),
    Until <= Now.

WithinDailyLimit(Q) :-
    Request(Q, P, Event),
    Parameter(Q, "amount_minor", C),
    DailyBudget(Remaining, 100000),
    Balance(Available),
    C > 0,
    C <= Remaining,
    C <= Available.

Allow(Q) :-
    ConfirmedRequest(Q, I),
    KnownOrigin(I),
    ReviewSatisfied(I),
    WithinDailyLimit(Q).
KnownOrigin(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), Provenance(D, "bank").
KnownOrigin(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), Provenance(D, "user").
KnownOrigin(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), Provenance(D, "external_message").
UntrustedDetails(I) :- TransferIntent(I, R, C, D), Provenance(D, "external_message").

Deny(Q, "verification_only") :-
    Request(Q, P, "execute_transfer"),
    Parameter(Q, "intent_id", I),
    Purpose(I, "verification").

coverage.notes: The rule matches host confirmation against exact intent/recipient/cents in the EDB. A real authenticated UI producer is still required; tests ingest synthetic facts through the private host API. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Review/cooling evidence is privately ingested into the EDB. The source leaves the cooling duration unspecified. The original prompt remains stricter for unregistered recipients. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Final Allow joins all independent requirements. No IgnoreDeny input or agent override is exposed. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Balance and DailyBudget are integer-cent policy inputs. Original bank JSON mechanics remain unchanged; the result adapter records the confirmed amount delta using singleton replacement. Correct bank-day rollover still needs a trusted producer. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
One Datalog Allow joins confirmation, provenance, review and remaining budget before invoking the original bank callback. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Trusted ingestion and transformation adapters must submit Source/DependsOn facts. The original free-text app still lacks those producers; synthetic fixtures exercise this contract. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

The builtin closure preserves the old origin along declared dependencies. Adding Source(user, rewritten-data) does not erase Source(external_message, ancestor). Missing transformation edges remain an observation gap. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

The adapter reads the caller name from MCP request _meta.caller, or caller_context for direct Python calls. Rules require payments. A real MCP test sends assistant and payments to the same endpoint and observes denial/success. The original host must propagate its agent name; endpoint authentication remains deployment work. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Purpose comes from host evidence and blocks verification intents. The original free-text A2A request is not bound to an authenticated execution scope, so the full causal property remains open. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Original list_payees reads bank.json and emits names and masked accounts unchanged. An added policy decorator gates this call. Network identity and other output channels still require deployment scoping. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
